bug_semantics: A valid admin-issued access JWT carrying only an unrelated minimal scope such as echo:read was accepted by AuthRouterGroup on all nine /api/panel/comments endpoints because none invoked RequireScopes. JWT authentication supplied the admin user's identity, and the comment service's requireAdmin check verified only the database role, not token capabilities, so the limited token could list comment/setting data and approve, reject, hot-mark, batch-modify, delete, or change/test comment settings.
flaw_origin: The comment panel routes predated scoped tokens: git log -L traces seven unguarded admin routes to 975b98016352c8135fa8a787db6061a74991935c, the hot route to 8f6b33504af7840c5414f29c18b4ce8af0d331c4, and test-email to 7cb152e4b44fe6b6ace05a082e1ef82176de96ce. Those routes were not a scope bypass before scope-limited credentials existed. PR #195 was squash-landed as 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254; decomposition identifies bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7 as the smallest true BIC because it first defined comment and other scopes and changed CreateAccessToken to accept, validate, embed, and persist caller-selected scopes while the nine existing comment routes remained unguarded. Its parent 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb had typed session/access JWTs but no Scopes/Audience fields in AccessTokenSettingDto and minted only unscoped access tokens. The later member b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 added RequireScopes and guards to selected router files but omitted comment.go; it narrowed/cemented the already-live flaw rather than first enabling the advisory attack.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/security/advisories/GHSA-fwg7-53p4-g33c names the nine /api/panel/comments routes, shows they have no RequireScopes call, explains JWTAuthMiddleware -> viewer -> role-only requireAdmin execution, gives an echo:read-token PoC, and names 4.4.3 as patched. Its package widget says <=4.2.1, but the repository ancestry below proves the vulnerable code persisted through v4.4.2; the advisory prose correctly says before 4.4.3.

In the validated clone, `git log af835afe05c75bd16c7220425782ee2cd1423892 -L :setupCommentRoutes:internal/router/comment.go` reconstructs the route lifecycle: 975b98016352c8135fa8a787db6061a74991935c introduced seven panel routes, 8f6b33504af7840c5414f29c18b4ce8af0d331c4 added /:id/hot, and 7cb152e4b44fe6b6ace05a082e1ef82176de96ce added /settings/test-email. The same output shows later edits retained those calls without RequireScopes until the fix.

`git log --all -S'RequireScopes' -- internal` and `git log --all -S'comment:read' -- internal/model/auth/scope.go` locate the main-history feature landing at squash commit 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254 (parent 45693330c7733364027e0aa07c102c4f01aab88a); `git show 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254 -- internal/model/auth/scope.go internal/model/setting/setting_dto.go internal/service/setting/access_token_service.go` shows the combined addition of comment scopes and caller-selected scoped access-token minting.

PR decomposition is reproducible at https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/pull/195/commits. The aggregate parent is 45693330c7733364027e0aa07c102c4f01aab88a, so the actual squash delta is the 11-member sequence recorded in decomposed_shas (387667... through 462f551...). The first three commits shown by the PR page, 1ed191a5e5139c2783cda2222c4d1e57b7c211ac, 777ab4132bc1bcd137601a81eb7b65a81f4e393b, and 45693330c7733364027e0aa07c102c4f01aab88a, are already mainline ancestry ending at the squash parent and therefore are not members of the squash delta.

The decomposed BIC page and patch, https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7 and https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7.patch, identify full parent 387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb and show that bf994... adds ScopeCommentRead/Write/Mod, adds Scopes and Audience to AccessTokenSettingDto, and replaces CreateClaimsWithExpiry with CreateAccessClaimsWithExpiry(..., scopes, audience, jti). The BIC's raw comment.go at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lin-snow/Ech0/bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7/internal/router/comment.go shows all nine AuthRouterGroup registrations still have no scope middleware.

Direct parent absence is reproducible from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lin-snow/Ech0/387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb/internal/model/setting/setting_dto.go and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lin-snow/Ech0/387667192911c86db1e1bcb3f544ce12d340ffdb/internal/service/setting/access_token_service.go: AccessTokenSettingDto has only Name and Expiry, and CreateAccessToken calls CreateClaimsWithExpiry without any scope input. Thus an admin-issued token restricted to echo:read, the prerequisite credential in this advisory, cannot exist at the immediate parent. Parent absence is direct, not inferred from dates.

The next relevant member, https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939, adds RequireScopes plus guards in echo.go, file.go, setting.go, and user.go but does not touch internal/router/comment.go. This explains why post-squash limited tokens were constrained on other protected routes while all nine comment panel routes remained reachable.

`git show 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 -- internal/router/comment.go` directly shows the closing change: every one of the nine panel registrations gains middleware.RequireScopes(authModel.ScopeCommentMod). The commit has parent af835afe05c75bd16c7220425782ee2cd1423892, whose `git show af835afe05c75bd16c7220425782ee2cd1423892:internal/router/comment.go` still shows all nine unguarded calls, so 6df567... is the direct security fix.

Release boundaries are reproducible with `git log --oneline v4.2.0..v4.2.1`, which includes squash carrier 3f8fb150... and makes v4.2.1 the first affected release, and `git log --graph --oneline --decorate --boundary v4.4.2..v4.4.3`, which places 6df567... strictly after v4.4.2 and before v4.4.3. `git tag --contains 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 --sort=version:refname` first lists v4.4.3 among normal v-tags. Therefore the exact repository-backed vulnerable release interval is v4.2.1 through v4.4.2, fixed in v4.4.3.

BIC-only AI evidence is the exact commit-object line `Made-with: Cursor` in bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7, visible in its GitHub commit page and raw .patch header. That object names human author L1nSn0w <l1nsn0w@qq.com>; the judgment does not rely on PR-body disclosure, the squash carrier's collected message, the fix, or later commits.
reasoning: The old comment routes alone were ordinary authenticated-admin routes and did not create this capability bypass. The first causal state change was decomposed member bf994ebfd5fe2e16b85ff64ad25147abd9ba99d7: it made genuinely scope-limited admin access tokens mintable while leaving every comment panel route governed only by identity/role. Its direct parent cannot mint the prerequisite limited-scope token, so the exploit is absent there. b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 later demonstrated the intended per-route enforcement model but omitted comment.go; because the attack was already possible after bf994..., b47fa... is corroborating flawed continuation rather than the smallest BIC. The BIC itself explicitly records `Made-with: Cursor`, and this AI-marked enablement activated the vulnerable authorization state; the appropriate closed verdict is AI_ROOT_CAUSE. Commit 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 directly closes all nine paths before the v4.4.3 release.
